      "evidence": "Modifies the C and C++ libbitcoinkernel interfaces, kernel error reporting, and notifications interface across kernel files.",

      "reason_tag": "unblocks #27587",

    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp are mechanical caller updates following the kernel notification API change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not address tooling functionality; bitcoin-chainstate is updated purely as a consumer of the kernel interface."
    },

      "name": "utils",
